_comment: Defence & Intelligence Career Mode presets and organisation profiles. Keywords steer evidence ranking only; they never add facts. Organisation notes are orientation summaries — always use the actual vacancy notification and verify recruitment details on official websites.

presets.name: Defence electronics and avionics
presets.description: Airborne electronics, avionics integration, qualification and test.

presets.name: Scientific and technical officer
presets.description: Government scientific posts combining R&D, instrumentation, documentation and administration.

presets.name: Radar, sensors and instrumentation
presets.description: Sensor systems, RF and radar, telemetry, calibration and measurement.

presets.name: AI/ML and computer vision
presets.description: Machine learning, deep learning and imaging research and deployment.

presets.name: Drone systems and autonomous technologies
presets.description: UAV platforms, payloads, autonomy, navigation and flight test.

presets.name: Embedded systems and edge computing
presets.description: Firmware, microcontrollers, FPGA, IoT and embedded GPU deployment.

presets.name: Scientific R&D
presets.description: Research-led roles valuing publications, methods and prototypes.

presets.name: Technical programme leadership
presets.description: Leading technical programmes, teams, procurement and reviews.

presets.name: Government technical deputation
presets.description: Deputation applications needing bio-data against essential qualifications and experience.

presets.name: Intelligence technology and analytical systems
presets.description: Technical analysis systems: imagery, signals, data, fusion and security.

organisations.name: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)
organisations.parent: Ministry of Defence, Government of India
organisations.notes: Posts are filled through official notifications (direct recruitment, lateral entry or deputation). Use the requirements in the actual advertisement.

organisations.name: National Technical Research Organisation (NTRO)
organisations.notes: Technical intelligence organisation. Do not assume internal processes; rely only on the published vacancy circular.

organisations.name: Aviation Research Centre (ARC)
organisations.notes: Aviation-related technical organisation. Check the exact post, mode of recruitment and eligibility in the circular.

organisations.name: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
organisations.parent: Department of Space, Government of India
organisations.notes: Use the specific centre's advertisement for qualifications and experience.

organisations.name: Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA)
organisations.parent: Ministry of Defence, Government of India
organisations.notes: Verify recruitment route and eligibility in the official notification.

organisations.name: CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL)
organisations.notes: CSIR laboratories publish their own advertisements; follow the prescribed format.

organisations.name: CSIR laboratories
organisations.notes: Scientist and technical officer posts are advertised by each laboratory.

organisations.name: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
organisations.parent: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
organisations.notes: MeitY programmes and C-DAC centres advertise separately; verify the centre and programme.

organisations.name: Department of Science and Technology (DST) programmes
organisations.parent: Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India
organisations.notes: Programme posts and fellowships have specific eligibility; read the call carefully.

organisations.name: Defence public sector undertakings (e.g. BEL, HAL)
organisations.notes: Industry roles; requirements and pay structures differ from government scientist posts.

organisations.name: National laboratories and scientific establishments
organisations.notes: Each establishment has its own recruitment rules and formats.

organisations.name: Civilian technical and scientific posts in the defence services
organisations.parent: Ministry of Defence, Government of India
organisations.notes: Notified through official channels; eligibility is set by recruitment rules for each post.
